mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 38 degrees with clear skies by City Hall and a waning crescent moon overhead.

Important updates from the city: pavement repairs are set for Tuesday and Wednesday on streets including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street, with parking restrictions in effect. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review new development projects for Liberty Business Park on December 7.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, look forward to the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.
A noteworthy call occurred on October 25, when officers located a man passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's featured flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The restaurant is currently open for business and will remain serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
